provenance: Captured on both native runtimes at source_commit with source_sdk. These V5 general/version-1 envelopes passed Decode, Checkable::check and Executive::validate_transaction. The regression test consumes these fixed bytes without generating signatures.
capture_recipe: At source_commit, create RuntimeGenesisConfig::default() test externalities (EIP-155 chain ID 20033) and an evm::Account::from_secret_key([7; 32]).

For each GenericTransaction type 0, 1 and 2, set from to the signer, to H160::repeat_byte(0x42), chain_id 20033, gas 10000000, gas_price and max_fee_per_gas to Pallet::<Runtime>::evm_base_fee() (1000000000), and max_priority_fee_per_gas 0. Use Default::default() for remaining fields (zero nonce/value, empty input/access list).
Call try_into_unsigned(), then account.sign_transaction(unsigned).signed_payload(). Put the payload in RuntimeCall::Revive(pallet_revive::Call::eth_transact { payload }).
Encode the body as [0x45, 1] followed by native_tx_extension(Era::Immortal, 0, 0).encode() and call.encode(). Prefix it with Compact(body.len() as u32).encode(); hex-encode the complete bytes.

For validation, set block number 1 and fund the signer substrate_account with 1000000000000000000000000. Decode UncheckedExtrinsic, check it with ChainContext::<Runtime>::default(), and call Executive::validate_transaction(TransactionSource::External, extrinsic, Default::default()).
